block_production.note: Different consensus model: there is no fixed per-span producer set like Bor; any validator may propose blocks in proportion to stake.

safe.note: Gnosis Safe; owners are addresses only — real-world identities not verified.

timelock.type: OZ v3 TimelockController (verified via bytecode + events)

TIMELOCK_ADMIN_ROLE.source: RoleGranted events (2022-02 deployment); see live_role_checks for current holders

sources.label: Ethereum JSON-RPC eth_getStorageAt / eth_call (matic.network proxy slots)

polygon_heimdall.params_authority: Heimdall x/gov module account — MsgUpdateParams checks the gov authority address (heimdall-v2 app wiring); validator-weighted voting.
polygon_heimdall.hardforks: Named hardfork heights are compiled into heimdalld binaries (helper/config.go); activation requires validator software adoption.

avalanche.mechanism: No on-chain admin key for Primary Network consensus rules. Named upgrades (Apricot..Helicon) activate at wall-clock timestamps compiled into avalanchego (upgrade/upgrade.go); validators must adopt new client software. Influence concentrates in client development + release coordination rather than a multisig.
